settings.custom_liquid:
<style>.cs-colour-hidden{display:none !important;}</style>
<script>
  (function () {
    var colours = {{ product.options_by_name['Colour'].values | json }};
    var optionKey = 'option{{ product.options_by_name['Colour'].position }}';
    var galleryId = 'MediaGallery-{{ section.id }}';

    function filterMedia(colour) {
      var gallery = document.getElementById(galleryId) || document.querySelector('media-gallery[id^="MediaGallery-"]');
      if (!gallery || !colour) return;
      gallery.querySelectorAll('li[data-media-id], li[data-target]').forEach(function (item) {
        var img = item.querySelector('img');
        var alt = img ? img.getAttribute('alt') || '' : '';
        var named = colours.filter(function (c) { return alt.indexOf(c) !== -1; });
        item.classList.toggle('cs-colour-hidden', named.length > 0 && named.indexOf(colour) === -1);
      });
      gallery.querySelectorAll('slider-component').forEach(function (slider) {
        if (typeof slider.resetPages === 'function') slider.resetPages();
      });
    }

    function listen() {
      filterMedia({{ product.options_by_name['Colour'].selected_value | json }});
      if (typeof subscribe !== 'function' || typeof PUB_SUB_EVENTS === 'undefined') return;
      subscribe(PUB_SUB_EVENTS.variantChange, function (event) {
        var variant = event && event.data && event.data.variant;
        if (variant) filterMedia(variant[optionKey]);
      });
    }

    filterMedia({{ product.options_by_name['Colour'].selected_value | json }});
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', listen);
    } else {
      listen();
    }
  })();
</script>

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content:
You can request a return within 14 days of receiving your order. Items must be unworn, unwashed and in their original condition with all original tags attached.

Return postage is covered by you, unless the item arrived faulty or damaged, or the wrong item was sent. We do not offer direct exchanges: return the item and place a new order.

To start a return, email office@chosenstudios.ch with your order number.

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content:
We ship within Switzerland and Liechtenstein for CHF 8.90. Orders from CHF 158 ship free.

Orders are dispatched within 1 to 3 working days and delivered by Swiss Post, usually within 2 to 3 working days after dispatch.
